Class AbstractIOMachine

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.items.BaseSTBItem
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.items.BaseSTBBlock
        • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.items.BaseSTBMachine

  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Chargeable, ChargeableBlock, InventoryGUIListener, STBInventoryHolder, io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.libraries.keys.Keyed, java.lang.Comparable<BaseSTBItem>, org.bukkit.inventory.InventoryHolder

    public abstract class AbstractIOMachine
extends AbstractProcessingMachine
    Represents a machine which processes items from its input slots to an internal processing store, and places resulting items in its output slots.

      • getTickRate

        public int getTickRate()
        Description copied from class: BaseSTBBlock
        Defines the rate at which the block ticks. BaseSTBBlock.onServerTick() will be called this frequently. Override this method to have the block tick at the desired frequency. The default rate of 0 means that the block will not tick at all.
        Overrides:
        getTickRate in class BaseSTBMachine

      • onServerTick

        public void onServerTick()
        Description copied from class: BaseSTBBlock
        Called every tick for each STB block that is placed in the world, for any STB block where BaseSTBBlock.getTickRate() returns a non-zero value. Override this method to define any periodic behaviour of the block.
        Overrides:
        onServerTick in class AbstractProcessingMachine

      • onBlockUnregistered

        public void onBlockUnregistered(org.bukkit.Location loc)
        Description copied from class: BaseSTBBlock
        Called when an STB block has been broken and is being unregistered. The block's location and GUI (if any) are still valid at this point, but all physical blocks have been set to AIR. Use this method to perform any block-specific shutdown tasks, e.g. drop items from inventory.
        Overrides:
        onBlockUnregistered in class AbstractProcessingMachine
        Parameters:
        loc - location of the base (primary) block of this STB block
